The canonical fold-0 checkpoint (byte-identical to the HF-served weights, sha256 11b43960...) measures 0.809/0.852; the 0.033 sibling-run spread is a direct estimate of training-run variability in the probe. finding: DANN reduces the NAIVE probe by 0.039 while leaving the disease-controlled probe unchanged (0.882 vs 0.885): it removed the disease-site correlation component, not site appearance. A naive probe overstates adversarial debiasing; the controlled probe is the honest instrument.

dose_response.reading: SUPERSEDED 2026-08-15 by results/rop/dann_probe_ci.json (patient-clustered CIs, hash-verified checkpoints): on the canonical checkpoints the controlled probe is 0.866 -> 0.852 -> 0.917 - NOT monotonic; the w=0->0.5 step is within noise (CI spans 0) and the w=2 jump is significant (+0.066, CI [+0.022,+0.115]). The durable claim: the adversary never reduces disease-controlled site decodability and significantly increases it at w=2, while costing clinical performance. The naive probe cannot see this.
